dod.description: Depth of discharge during aging sections (%)

soc_mean.description: Mean state of charge during aging sections (%)

c_rate_chg.description: Charge C-rate during aging sections (no unit)

c_rate_dch.description: Discharge C-rate during aging sections (no unit)

soc_max.description: Maximum SOC during cycling (% — derived as soc_mean + dod/2, center-balanced)

soc_min.description: Minimum SOC during cycling (% — derived as soc_mean - dod/2, center-balanced)

total_efc.description: Total equivalent full cycles in the experiment

total_ah.description: Total ampere-hours throughput (Ah) in the experiment

total_exp_days.description: Total number of elapsed days of experiment

total_cyc_days.description: Total number of cycling days in the experiment
